label: Plato, Phaedo 99a–b: In the account of his own action, Socrates grants that without bones, sinews…
interpretation: Bounded prose source reading of the materialized Burnet Greek witness. The bodily requirements are granted, not eliminated. The contrast concerns the explanation of this intelligent action; it does not establish that every physical cause is merely a condition, that embodied action is physically uncaused, or that the choice already has an adequate explanation.
